body: Gallium nitride's bandgap is about 3.4 eV, roughly three times silicon's 1.1 eV. That lets it survive about ten times the electric field before breaking down, so GaN power chips can be far smaller.

scene_notes.caption: Wider bandgap means a higher breakdown field.
